findings.verified: Both original pages visually reviewed. Article 3 adds CIT Article 4(14a), exempting income of Vietnam-established enterprises/organizations with revenue at or below a government-set threshold. Article 5(2) applies Articles 1-3 from 1 January 2026, distinct from the general approval-date commencement.

Original pages visually reviewed. Article 3 grants a 30% CIT reduction for 2026/2027 to qualifying Vietnam-established entities with annual revenue not exceeding VND 10 billion (inclusive). Reduction follows other incentives; revenue includes sales/services without revenue deductions, financial revenue and other income. Dependent units and split-entity aggregation conditions apply. Article 4 states commencement 29 October 2026 and application to 2026/2027 tax periods.

Article 2 adds Decree 320/2025 Article 4(15): inclusive VND 1 billion threshold uses preceding tax-period statutory revenue; periods under 12 months annualize actual revenue by active months times 12, with specified partial establishment/reorganization months counted in full. New current-period enterprises use separate provisional/year-end actual rules. Subsidiary/linked-company exclusion applies where a related enterprise fails exemption eligibility. Article 3 commences 1 January 2026; Article 4(3) has a separate allocation for a 2025 tax year ending in 2026.

Original pages visually reviewed. Article2 applies to resident individual business-income tax for2026/2027, irrespective of tax method, using complete statutory business revenue under Decree68 Articles4-5 as amended by Decree141. Year-end actual revenue above VND10 billion removes relief; provisional withholding and subsequent adjustment rules are separate from final annual relief.
